business_overview.revenue_model: Product sales revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers; domestic revenue is recognized on delivery and receipt by customers, while major overseas sales are recognized when goods are loaded and depart from ports.
business_notes: 2024 operating revenue was RMB92.746bn, up 8.35% YoY.
Domestic principal operating revenue was RMB47.994bn and overseas principal operating revenue was RMB35.629bn.
Direct sales contributed RMB59.296bn and distribution contributed RMB24.328bn of principal operating revenue.
